name.description: Display name shown in the editor and game.

icon.description: Relative path to the icon image asset (from project root).

description.description: Long description shown to the player in the inventory UI.

maxStackSize.description: Maximum number of this item that can occupy a single inventory slot.

pickupSound.description: Relative path to the audio clip played when the item is picked up. Optional — falls back to the ItemManager default.

classId.description: Optional reference to a project-level ItemClass definition (e.g. 'seed', 'weapon'). Drives extra typed properties on this item.

classProperties.description: Values for the extra properties defined by the assigned ItemClass.
